name: threejs-lab
description: Three.js demo gallery: one shared engine + a manifest-driven registry (engine/registry.js). Zero build step — the site is static files + an import map + pinned three via unpkg (see index.html). This package.json exists only so the repo's .js files are valid ES modules for Node tooling (e.g. the verify/perf harnesses in verify/); the site never reads it.
